_comment: Predefined fixed clip set (PI request, 2026-08-02): the same clips are shown to every participant -- only presentation order is randomized per participant (see emotion_task.clip_selection_mode: fixed in session_config.yaml). Positive/negative groups ranked by HIGHEST arousal_score (video_data.csv 'arousal_wsd' column, used as a proxy for strong emotion induction -- NOT the raw 'arousal' column, which mixes inconsistent units across rows); neutral group ranked by LOWEST arousal_score (calmest). Regenerate with scripts/select_fixed_emotion_clips.py [--n-per-group N].
